title: Tenant Saga roadmap synthesis: quarter cadence, escape-hatches, and OKR telemetry
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Objective: Produce an actionable quarterly roadmap artifact that aligns Private/VPC/on-prem hosting work to measurable OKRs and a single critical-path heatmap (the 'Tenant Saga') to guide releases and rollouts.

Scope:
- Synthesize existing tranche plans, compatibility gates, and upgrade windows into a single quarter cadence that prioritizes customer-facing stability for regulated tenants.
- Define escape-hatch runbooks (rollback, traffic siphon, read-only fallback) per activation cohort.
- Specify telemetry and OKR signals to gate canary -> wave -> GA progression (latency P95, error-rate, upgrade failure-rate, activation success-rate).
- Produce acceptance criteria, risk matrix, and a prioritized set of tactical engineering/ops tickets for the quarter.

Deliverables:
1) Tenant Saga Heatmap (primary deliverable) — visual critical path mapping of milestones, ownership, and hard/soft gates.
2) Escape-hatch runbook templates for 3 failure classes with playbook owners.
3) OKR telemetry dashboard spec (events, thresholds, alerting) to be handed to Observability/ENG.
4) Roadmap slice with clear dependencies and tranche activation schedule for customers in cohort A/B/C.

Success metrics:
- Reduce upgrade activation failure-rate to <2% for priority cohorts within quarter.
- 95th percentile rollback completion < 15 minutes for production activations.
- All waves gated by automated telemetry (no manual-only guardrails).

Acceptance criteria:
- Heatmap reviewed and approved by Engineering leads, Solutions, and Support.
- Runbook templates tested in one staged activation (internal sandbox).
- OKR telemetry prototype dashboard with synthetic data available before canary.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Interdependent infra work slips (kernel/quantization changes). Mitigation: conservative gating and a fallback model variant in routing policies.
- Risk: Missing telemetry instrumentation on customer upgrade path. Mitigation: allocate 2pt spike in Cycle to add events and schema.
